summary.headline: Khata'i Lunar Month Table
summary.text: Tabular introduction to the transformation and beginnings of the seasons and Khata'i lunar months, giving entry days, complete and incomplete month days, annual totals, signs, period names, cycle numbers, and durations. The table includes Sïchqan, Aram Ar, Wa Wasi, Toshqan, Andar Ar, Muywand, Tunguz, and other month or season names, with Alexandrian and Malikshahi calendar annotations.
